title: Michele Pickleball Anthem - G4 Clean
style: soul blues gospel phonk, cinematic orchestral pads, 145 BPM, heavy sliding 808, crisp cowbell, chopped female vocal, layered male chants, Spanish licks, Mandarin licks, stadium crowd, vinyl crackle, festival energy, loud club master, pure pickleball hype
lyrics:
[Intro - Whisper + pads]
Her pickleball way up high in the sky...
It's talking to her... she hears the reply...
Wind in her favor... timeless...

[Verse 1]
Power in the fire, speed in the flame...
When every shot says none is right...
Michele still smashes... smashes... smashes!

[Pre-Drop]
¡Vamos! ¡SMASH!

[Drop 1]
SMASH IT! SMASH IT!
Go for it, the time is right now!
Sooooo... SMASH IT!

[Mandarin]
加油! 力量! 永远!

[Verse 2]
Point over, you're in overdrive!
¡SMASH IT! Fast steps shining bright!

[Bridge]
Her pickleball way up high in the sky...
It's talking to her... she hears the reply...

[Final Drop]
Michele in overdrive... ¡Vamos!
Pickleball forever... 永远!
SMASH IT! 加油! 力量!

[Outro]
Michele... Pickleball... forever...
